openwrt_wiki.5ghz_phy: The chip Ubiquiti U-AME-G1-BR4A seems to be a custom labeled QCA9882-BR4A (2x2:2 MIMO). It is detected as QCA988X/hw2.0 and supported by the ath10k driver.
openwrt_wiki.leds: The UniFi AP AC has two LEDs (ubnt:white:dome, ubnt:blue:dome)
openwrt_wiki.serial_console: The device has two pinheaders with serial ports. Both ports operate at 3.3V level, 115200 Baud, 8N1 and have the pinout +3,3V - RX - TX - GND. The port to the left (shown red) gives access to U-Boot and OpenWrt's console. The purpose of the other port (shown blue) is not identified yet. Using the default/factory U-Boot environment there are no outputs from the kernel during booting. Instead, one has to send a newline at 9600 Baud (to activate the console) and then login at 115200 Baud again. (setenv bootargs 'console=ttyS0,115200 panic=3'; saveenv)
openwrt_wiki.serial_port_2: CLI>build_version=0x11, rom_version=0x41020000, ram_version=0x11, stack_size=6348 / reset reason=0x0 / Image startup of Normal mode
installation: Non-invasive method using mtd-tools from OpenWrt
Non-invasive method using mtd from unifi
openwrt_wiki.installation_hinweis: Stock-Firmware 3.7.58 (Bootloader) als Ausgangspunkt; Firmware 6.7.35 laut Seite mit dd-Methode nicht funktionierend (AC Lite); manche Stock-Firmwares sperren mtd-Partitionen (Forum https://forum.openwrt.org/t/uap-ac-lr-openwrt-install/163143/3)
openwrt_wiki.reset_verhalten: Reset gedrückt beim Einschalten: nach ca. 5 s blaue LED, cfg-Partition gelöscht; weitere 8 s: U-Boot-Env auf Standard, TFTP-Server auf 192.168.1.20 (Client 192.168.1.254), LEDs blau/weiß blinkend; nimmt nur Images mit Firmware-Header. Reset-Taste am Gerät oder am PoE-Injektor.
openwrt_wiki.tftp_recovery: Reset beim Einstecken des PoE-Kabels halten, bis LED-Ring weiß/blau/aus blinkt (ca. 15 s); UAP ist dann TFTP-Server 192.168.1.20 (kein Ping, kein DHCP); Stock-Image BZ.qca956x....bin per TFTP PUT
